initialize_pix2pixhd_model: initialize a Pix2PixHDModel with opt config to set up generator, discriminator, and encoder networks for training
forward_pix2pixhd_training: run the forward pass of Pix2PixHDModel to compute GAN, VGG, style, and reconstruction losses during training
inference_pix2pixhd: run inference with Pix2PixHDModel to generate fake images from label and instance maps using sampled features
encode_features_pix2pixhd: encode features from an image and instance map using the encoder network for later feature swapping or broadcasting
swap_features_pix2pixhd: swap features between condition and reference feature maps by ID for conditional image generation inference
